annotations.description: Casting Kaito before combat is suboptimal. Preacher of the Schism is about to attack, and if the opponent is at the highest life or tied, it creates a vampire token. More importantly, if Kimi25 Spike has the most life (18 vs 16), Preacher draws a card on attack. By casting Kaito pre-combat, they miss the opportunity to use Kaito's Ninjutsu ability — if Preacher attacks and is unblocked (opponent has no creatures), they could return Preacher to hand and put Kaito onto the battlefield tapped and attacking via Ninjutsu for {1}{U}{B}, saving 1 mana. Additionally, Kaito attacking as a 3/4 would deal combat damage, and then using his 0 ability would draw a card since the opponent lost life this turn. They also lose the Preacher attack trigger (draw + vampire token). However, casting Kaito normally and then attacking with both Kaito (as a 3/4 creature during your turn) and Preacher could also be strong. But the Ninjutsu line is strictly better: pay 3 mana for Kaito via Ninjutsu, Kaito deals combat damage, use 0 ability to surveil 2 and draw 1 (opponent lost life), then replay Preacher post-combat or next turn. The Ninjutsu line saves mana and generates card advantage, while pre-combat Kaito means he can still attack but you don't get the surprise ninjutsu value and you telegraph to the opponent.

Combined with Deep-Cavern Bat (1/1 flying) and Flitterwing Nuisance (1/1 flying), that's exactly 6 damage for lethal with no available blockers.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority during combat without activating Restless Reef, missing lethal damage.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Restless Reef for 2UB to make it a 4/4 creature, then attack with Restless Reef + Deep-Cavern Bat + Flitterwing Nuisance for exactly 6 lethal damage.

annotations.description: Requiting Hex can only destroy a creature with mana value 2 or less. The opponent's only creature is Superior Spider-Man (MV 4), which is not a legal target. The player would either need to target their own creature (terrible) or the spell fizzles. Meanwhile, Bitter Triumph in hand could destroy Superior Spider-Man, and they should also play a land first (Island or Gloomlake Verge) since they haven't played one this turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Cast Requiting Hex, apparently misunderstanding the card as dealing damage to the opponent's face.
annotations.betterLine: Play a land (Island or Gloomlake Verge), then cast Bitter Triumph targeting Superior Spider-Man to remove the opponent's main threat, or hold up Floodpits Drowner / Bitter Triumph for the opponent's turn with open mana.

annotations.description: Targeted a 1/1 Vampire Token with Bitter Triumph instead of the 4/4 Superior Spider-Man. Superior Spider-Man is currently tapped but will untap and be a significant blocker next turn, while a Vampire Token is a minimal threat. At 6 life, the opponent needs to block effectively and Superior Spider-Man is their best blocker.
annotations.actionTaken: Used Bitter Triumph to destroy a Vampire Token
annotations.betterLine: Target Superior Spider-Man with Bitter Triumph to remove the opponent's largest blocker and push through lethal damage on the following turn

annotations.description: Missed a free land drop with two lands in hand (Gloomlake Verge and Island). Playing an additional land provides more mana next turn for activating Restless Reef ({2}{U}{B}) or casting future draws, with no downside.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to play a land despite having Gloomlake Verge and Island in hand.
annotations.betterLine: Play Island (enters untapped) or Gloomlake Verge to have more mana available next turn, especially for Restless Reef activation.

annotations.description: Bringer of the Last Gift is likely the game-winning play here. It wipes the opponent's board (Deep-Cavern Bat, Flitterwing Nuisance), then DSV3 gets back Overlord of the Balemurk (5/5), Spider-Man, and Deceit from graveyard plus keeps Bringer (6/6 flying), creating an overwhelming board. Opponent only gets back Kaito and Floodpits Drowner. At 7 life facing that board, the game is essentially over.
annotations.actionTaken: Appears to have been calculating Ardyn's mana cost, likely choosing Ardyn, the Usurper or Formidable Speaker instead of Bringer of the Last Gift
annotations.betterLine: Cast Bringer of the Last Gift for the massive board swing - sacrifice Spider-Man, opponent sacrifices their creatures, then rebuild with Overlord, Deceit, and Spider-Man from graveyard while keeping the 6/6 flyer

annotations.description: Kimi25 Spike attacked with only the two Deep-Cavern Bats for 2 damage when they could have also activated Restless Reef ({2}{U}{B}) to make it a 4/4 deathtouch attacker with no blockers available (Superior Spider-Man is tapped). This would deal 6 total damage (8→2) instead of 2 (8→6), putting the opponent in critical range.
annotations.actionTaken: Attacked with only the two Deep-Cavern Bats for 2 damage total.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Restless Reef for {2}{U}{B} using Swamp, Gloomlake Verge, Watery Grave, and Soulstone Sanctuary, then attack with Restless Reef (4/4 deathtouch) plus both Deep-Cavern Bats for 6 total damage, putting opponent to 2 life.

annotations.description: Declined to activate Restless Reef as a 4/4 attacker, missing 4 extra damage (plus mill 4 trigger). This would have put the opponent from 8 to 2 life instead of 6, significantly increasing pressure. The opponent's Superior Spider-Man is tapped so there are no blockers. Keeping mana open for Tragic Trajectory is less valuable since -2/-2 doesn't kill the 4/4 Spider-Man without the void condition being met.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed on activating Restless Reef, attacking with only two 1/1 Deep-Cavern Bats for 2 damage.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Restless Reef for {2}{U}{B} and attack with it alongside both bats for 6 total damage (putting opponent to 2) plus the mill 4 trigger, while gaining 2 life from bat lifelink to go to 8.

annotations.description: Opponent is at 6 life with their only creature (Superior Spider-Man) tapped. Activating Restless Reef for {2}{U}{B} would create a 4/4 deathtouch attacker that can't be blocked, dealing 4 damage and putting the opponent to 2 life. With Tragic Trajectory in hand, this sets up lethal next turn or even potentially this turn with the mill trigger. Declining to activate wastes a free 4 damage.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to activate any lands, missing a free 4-damage attack with Restless Reef.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Restless Reef for {2}{U}{B} to make it a 4/4 deathtouch creature and attack with it, dealing 4 damage to put the opponent to 2 life.

annotations.description: Opponent is at 6 life with their only creature (Superior Spider-Man) tapped, meaning no blockers available. Activating Restless Reef as a 4/4 deathtouch attacker would deal 4 damage (plus mill 4), bringing opponent to 2 life. The player had sufficient mana to activate Restless Reef (2UB) and still keep a Swamp untapped for Tragic Trajectory if needed.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to activate Restless Reef and passed without attacking.
annotations.betterLine: Activate Restless Reef for {2}{U}{B}, attack with the 4/4 deathtouch Shark to deal 4 damage to the opponent at 6 life with no available blockers, putting them to 2 and in a nearly unrecoverable position.
